content.title: 'Daredevil: Born Again' is back for Season 2: Release date, time, how to watch
content.text: Disney+, Marvel Studios It’s time to dance with the Devil — again. One year after rebooting the franchise within the Marvel Cinematic Universe, the Man Without Fear is back in “Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 on Disney+. The new season picks up where the last left off; crime lord Wilson Fisk a.k.a. Kingpin (Vincent D’Onofrio) is the Mayor of New York City and Matt Murdock (Charlie Cox), a blind lawyer by day who protects Hell’s Kitchen as a vigilante known as Daredevil by night, is gathering allies to fight back against his greatest adversary, Fisk and the “Anti-Vigilante Task Force.” Krysten Ritter is set to join “Daredevil: Born Again” this season, reprising the role of Jessica Jones from Marvel’s Netflix television universe, where Cox’s version of Daredevil also originated. In September 2025, a third season was confirmed to be in development, so these eight episodes won’t be the last you see of Daredevil. ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 release date The first episode of “Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 premieres tonight, March 24, on Disney+. ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 release time All episodes of “Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 will drop on their respective release dates at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT. How to watch ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 “Daredevil: Born Again” is exclusive to Disney+, so you’ll need a subscription to stream new episodes. Disney+ offers a number of subscription options, so you can find the one that works for you. With ads, a subscription costs $10.99/month; without ads, it’s $18.99/month or $189.99/year. There are also Disney+ bundles with Hulu, HBO Max, and ESPN+, so you can subscribe to up to three services at once and save over 40% every month. The bundles are available in a few different configurations, starting at $12.99/month for Disney+ and Hulu with ads, and going up to $32.99/month for Disney+, Hulu, and Max ad-free. ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 release schedule and episode guide “Daredevil: Born Again” Season 2 will have eight episodes, one less than the nine-episode first season. Below, check out the Disney+ release date for each episode. Episode 1: “The Northern Star” – March 24 Episode 2: “Shoot the Moon” – March 31 Episode 3: “The Scales and the Sword” – March 31 Episode 4: “Gloves Off” – April 7 Episode 5: “The Grand Design” – April 14 Episode 6: “Requiem” – April 21 Episode 7: “The Hateful Darkness” – April 28 Episode 8: “The Southern Cross” – May 5 On May 12, a Marvel Studios Special Presentation titled “The Punisher: One Last Kill” will premiere, continuing Frank Castle / The Punisher’s story from “Daredevil: Born Again.” Castle will again be played by Jon Bernthal, who is also set to appear in July’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.” ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 cast Most of the Season 1 cast of “Daredevil: Born Again” are set to return, including: Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock / Daredevil, a blind lawyer with superhuman senses from Hell’s Kitchen, New York, who leads a double life as a masked vigilante. Vincent D’Onofrio as Wilson Fisk / Kingpin, a powerful businessman and crime lord who is the mayor of New York City Margarita Levieva as Heather Glenn, a therapist and Murdock’s ex-girlfriend who is Fisk’s Mental Health Commissioner Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, a former reporter and Murdock’s friend and former partner at the Nelson, Murdock & Page law firm Elden Henson as Franklin “Foggy” Nelson, Murdock’s best friend and former law partner who was assassinated in the first season Wilson Bethel as Benjamin “Dex” Poindexter / Bullseye, a psychopathic assassin and former FBI agent who is a highly skilled marksman capable of using almost any object as a lethal projectile Zabryna Guevara as Sheila Rivera, Fisk’s mayoral campaign director Nikki M. James as Kirsten McDuffie, a former New York assistant district attorney and Murdock’s former law partner Genneya Walton as BB Urich, a journalist for The BB Report and the niece of the late Ben Urich Arty Froushan as Buck Cashman, Fisk’s right-hand man and fixer Clark Johnson as Cherry, a retired NYPD officer who works as an investigator at the Murdock & McDuffie law firm Michael Gandolfini as Daniel Blake, Fisk’s protégé and the Deputy Mayor of Communications Ayelet Zurer as Vanessa Fisk, Wilson’s wife who is part of his criminal empire Tony Dalton as Jack Duquesne / Swordsman: A wealthy socialite who is secretly a sword-wielding vigilante Additionally, Krysten Ritter reprises her role as Jessica Jones, a former vigilante and the owner of a detective agency. Ritter first played Jones in Marvel’s Netflix series “Jessica Jones” and teamed up with Daredevil in “The Defenders” miniseries. Matthew Lillard is also set to join the cast as Mr. Charles, an antagonist for Fisk at the “politics and international diplomacy” level. While it hasn’t been confirmed that Jon Bernthal will return as Frank Castle / The Punisher in the new season, as we noted above, it will conclude with the premiere of the special presentation “The Punisher: One Last Kill,” which Bernthal leads. ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 trailer Why Trust Post Wanted by the New York Post This article was written by Angela Tricarico, Commerce Streaming Reporter for Post Wanted Shopping, Page Six, and Decider.com.
